limite: The content stays in this tab. No application is sent or submitted.
ayuda_texto: On the Bolsa preparation page, select “Download JSON draft”. That file restores the supplied requirements, dates and documents. The TXT summary is not compatible. Download the same JSON here to retain it. Recovery does not verify its source, identity, validity, signature, payment or registration.
archivo_pista: Preparation JSON file, up to 2 MiB. The TXT summary is not compatible.
recuperado: Preparation recovered from the file. Its source remains unverified.
error_archivo: The summary could not be recovered. Use the preparation JSON file; TXT is not compatible. Check the size limit, unsubmitted status and pending requirements.
datos_vacios: Choose a file to see its content.
segun_archivo: Data from the file, not checked against the source of the call.
lectura: Reading status stated in the file
lectura_si: Marked as reviewed; identity remains unverified.
sin_datos: This section of the file contains no data.
ruta_no_verificada: Unchecked path. The document is not opened or downloaded.
archivo_metadatos: {nombre} · {tamano} declared bytes; the original file is not recovered.
guardado: Download prepared with the same bytes as the original file. No application is submitted.
pendiente_fuente: Check the source, version and validity of the selection rules.
pendiente_formulario: Obtain the form and documents accepted by HR.
pendiente_identidad: Establish identity and, where applicable, representation. Being an employee is not required to prepare an application.
pendiente_circuito: Determine the applicable fee or exemption and complete the custody, signature and submission procedure that applies.
origen_json: Choose a call to prepare an application
